relation: simple-graph stable sets of a supplied vertex set, with upstream GraphTheory.core.dom.stable S ([disjoint NS(S) & S], Boolean) canonical: Chromatic X3 x3_stable_set, Chromatic/Extremal/Packing XE1 xe1_stable_set, Extremal X56 x56_stable_set and Packing X18 x18_independent_set (x -- y -> False for all supplied pairs) are iffs with it by GTBase.stable_sets.stable_noedgeP; Extremal X97 x97_stable_set and GTMisc X169/X208 x169_stable_set/x208_stable_set (x != y -> ~~ (x -- y)) by stable_distinctP; GTMisc X29 x29_stable_set (~~ (x -- y) for all supplied pairs, the diagonal included) by stable_nonadjP; GTMisc X163 x163_stableb ([forall x in S, [forall y in S, (x == y) || ~~ (x -- y)]]) is EQUAL to stable S by stable_eqbE. The variants agree by sgraph irreflexivity, with no nonempty, cardinality or looplessness guard; directed stable sets (which must also exclude loops) are a separate contract.
summary: Batch A, family A20 (simple-graph stable sets), on the fixed A19 pin 96be00e (no private union). Canonical: upstream GraphTheory.core.dom.stable. The new GTBase.stable_sets proves raw views only, adding no predicate: the reflections stable_noedgeP, stable_nonadjP and stable_distinctP, the Boolean equality stable_eqbE and the two-vertex case stable_pair. The eleven sources now unfold to stable S: ten Prop iffs and X163's Boolean equality. The public client: the empty set and K_0, singletons, the whole edgeless carrier, both K_2 vertices rejected together, hereditary restriction, induced-subgraph transport, the raw views and the bounded Boolean form.

Frozen verbatim at 96be00e: the eleven sources, the fifteen row-reaching chains (XE2 cochromatic colouring, number and maximum on n; X56 homogeneous set; X97 maximum independent set, hitting set and hitting number; X163 Boolean normality; X169 token sliding and polytime decision; X208 maximum-size output and polytime; X29 stable cover and normality; Packing XE1 triangle-free guarantee), Extremal XE1's dormant xe1_has_independent_set, and the seventeen rows. Complete rows at the pre-migration 9e03072: X3 (B1+B3), Chromatic #762 (A5), Extremal X56 (A1+A6), #802 (A5), #22 (A5+A7), #801 (A7), GTMisc X29 (A6), X169 (C13, with its polytime chain) and Packing #151 (A18): 26 whole-row iffs in all; the bridges reuse the earlier certificates. Finite palettes, attained extrema, quantifier orders, guards, natural subtraction, trunc_log, X163's Boolean event, X169's blocked encoding and X208's numeric output and witnesses are unchanged.

History: fifteen earlier frozen bodies keep live stable-set names byte-for-byte and are documented below; A20's per-row copies keep the earlier families' live names (reciprocal notes in their specs). Proof consumers: Chromatic X7's cochromatic-gap application adapts its raw-forall scripts through stable_noedgeP with unchanged theorem types; vocabulary_packing's X18/XE1 bridge and all earlier certificates are unchanged. B21's X18 and B22's X208/X3 histories lie outside A19 ancestry: their complete compositions are a mandatory, separately reviewed pre-merge follow-up.
